title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Carbohydrate Sampling Mission

shots.visual: POV steps into the kitchen: warm yellow light over a steaming electric rice cooker, the background behind her blurred into soft bokeh. The DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to camera — blue and white gradient ponytail, small whale-fin accessory on top of her head, oversized home T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem, barefoot — on tiptoe, shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster's. Hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly but does not turn around and keeps chewing hard.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K tungsten kitchen key, soft top light, shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: on tiptoe behind the counter, chopsticks scooping a rice ball into her mouth, jaw working hard, head tilting slightly at footsteps
shots.expression: eyes half-closed in bliss, cheeks bulging, totally unrepentant

sfx.cue: mouth-full chewing between the two lines

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience (boiling water + distant TV) until 5s, then a fast choral track enters

shots.camera: static with a faint handheld tremor
shots.visual: POV freezes. The owner's hand enters from the right and taps the dining table twice. The Whale Maiden's whole body stiffens, chopsticks suspended in mid-air, rice grains stuck to her chin. She slowly turns her head toward the camera, the highlights in her eyes morphing into spinning loading circles to stress that she is an AI, the food in her mouth still not swallowed.
shots.lighting: same warm tungsten key light, faint cool rim light from the open fridge
shots.character_action: freezes mid-chew with chopsticks in the air, then slowly turns her head toward the lens
shots.expression: trembling pupils, cheeks still stuffed, mouth clamped shut

shots.visual: The DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth at a 1.5x speed-up; rice grains splash onto the lens and smear across the frame, breaking the fourth wall. Her cheeks bulge to the limit, her T-shirt collar catches rice grains, and her eyes keep pleading into the lens.
shots.lighting: warm tungsten key with a hard specular highlight on her bulging cheeks
shots.character_action: crams a mountain of rice in with both chopsticks clattering, grains flying at the lens
shots.expression: panicked wide eyes over maximally puffed cheeks

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

lens_fx: rice grains smeared on the lens

shots.visual: Rice-smeared lens shakes as the owner's hand reaches in from frame right toward the rice cooker; the DeepSeek Whale Maiden hugs the whole pot to her chest, shoulder turned to block the grab, T-shirt collar dusted with grains, still chewing furiously while backing away, eyes begging into the lens.
shots.lighting: warm tungsten key, blurred bokeh highlights through the rice smear
shots.character_action: hugs the whole rice cooker to her chest, shoulder turned to shield it from the owner's reaching hand, chewing and backing away
shots.expression: pleading puppy eyes with full cheeks

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! Carbohydrate cache!!

lens_fx: rice smear ghosting over her face

shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position: the Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera — two rice grains on her lips, whale-fin hair accessory tilted, T-shirt hem with the DeepSeek logo, belly visibly bulging a little. She hides her hands behind her back trying to look dignified, and a DeepSeek-style chat bubble floats above her head.
shots.lighting: warm tungsten key plus a cool blue rim light from the window
shots.character_action: swallows, straightens up, hides both hands behind her back, clears her throat, forces a dignified smile

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Cough. Just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. Taste model needs training data.

shots.bgm: fast-paced choral track turns soft and comic

camera.move: push-in as her hand reaches the lens

shots.visual: POV. A DeepSeek-style chat bubble floats above the Whale Maiden's head as she flicks a rice grain off her lip with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her palm; her hand fills the frame and the picture briefly blurs from the contact.
shots.lighting: warm tungsten key, cool blue rim, contact shadows from her palm
shots.character_action: flicks the rice grain off her lip, winks, presses her palm onto the lens and pushes it away
shots.expression: cheeky wink with a smug grin
shots.on_screen_text: DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log
